useCases.title: Attacks — standard grip

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

attacks.name: flail smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

Ordinary tables halve decay; chests, platters, food vendors, artifact backpacks and cooling tables pause it. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

attacks.name: flail smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

attacks.name: staggering cleave
attacks.description: A powerful blow that delivers Strength-scaling knockback and slowdown to the target. The amount of inflicted knockback scales off your Strength, ranging from X (1 tile) to XIII (3 tiles). </br>Cannot inflict any knockback or slowdown if your Strength is below X. </br>Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. </br>Prone targets halve the knockback distance. </br>Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.title: Weapon & shield
useCases.note: Force is the starting melee damage value, not guaranteed health damage. Attack mode, grip, stats, skill, quality, armor and item condition affect the result. A zero wielded override does not mean the weapon deals zero damage.

useCases.title: Attacks — standard grip

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

useCases.title: Attacks — standard grip

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

shelfLife.label: About 35 minutes unprotected, then becomes rotten meat
shelfLife.conditions: Approximate time from a newly created item, including its initial warm period, while unprotected. Ordinary tables halve decay; chests, platters, food vendors, artifact backpacks and cooling tables pause it. Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate. This decay timer creates the named replacement instead of simply spoiling this item. Replacement waits while the item is held directly by a character. Protected storage pauses this transformation too. The replacement has no further food rot timer.

shelfLife.label: Does not rot under the food decay system
shelfLife.conditions: The initial rotprocess is null or false. This does not prevent burning or other damage.

quality.label: Fit for the desperate
quality.conditions: Base fare before serving. A platter raises food one rank, up to Lavish; favorites and hated foods have separate effects.

Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate. This decay timer creates the named replacement instead of simply spoiling this item. Replacement waits while the item is held directly by a character. Protected storage pauses this transformation too. The replacement has no further food rot timer.

shelfLife.label: Does not rot under the food decay system
shelfLife.conditions: The initial rotprocess is null or false. This does not prevent burning or other damage.

useCases.title: Weapon & shield
useCases.note: Force is the starting melee damage value, not guaranteed health damage. Attack mode, grip, stats, skill, quality, armor and item condition affect the result. A zero wielded override does not mean the weapon deals zero damage.

useCases.title: Attacks — standard grip

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.title: Attacks — standard grip

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

attacks.name: staggering cleave
attacks.description: A powerful blow that delivers Strength-scaling knockback and slowdown to the target. The amount of inflicted knockback scales off your Strength, ranging from X (1 tile) to XIII (3 tiles). </br>Cannot inflict any knockback or slowdown if your Strength is below X. </br>Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. </br>Prone targets halve the knockback distance. </br>Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.title: Attacks — standard grip

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

shelfLife.label: About 95 minutes unprotected (90 minutes rot timer)
shelfLife.conditions: Approximate time from a newly created item, including its initial warm period, while unprotected. Ordinary tables halve decay; chests, platters, food vendors, artifact backpacks and cooling tables pause it. Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate.

quality.label: Lavish
quality.conditions: Base fare before serving. A platter raises food one rank, up to Lavish; favorites and hated foods have separate effects.

value.label: No fixed base value; recipe-derived appraisal may apply
value.conditions: Base source value, not a guaranteed sale quote. Appraisal may randomize it by about 13%; crafted quality, derived recipe prices, loot status and the buyer can change the result.

useCases.title: Handling & durability
useCases.note: Initial source values. The normal furnace produces one result per item and ignores the declared recycle count. Damage, quality, enchantments and item interactions can change other values. Item size is an inventory class, not weight in kilograms.

useCases.title: Container & storage
useCases.note: Capacity and transfer amounts use the game’s source reagent units. Grid space, item footprints, size limits and type restrictions apply together. The item-count ceiling is not the number of objects that fit in the grid. Additional insertion rules can be set during play.

shelfLife.label: About 35 minutes unprotected (30 minutes rot timer)
shelfLife.conditions: Approximate time from a newly created item, including its initial warm period, while unprotected. Ordinary tables halve decay; chests, platters, food vendors, artifact backpacks and cooling tables pause it. Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate.

quality.label: Fit for the desperate
quality.conditions: Base fare before serving. A platter raises food one rank, up to Lavish; favorites and hated foods have separate effects.

value.label: No fixed base value; recipe-derived appraisal may apply
value.conditions: Base source value, not a guaranteed sale quote. Appraisal may randomize it by about 13%; crafted quality, derived recipe prices, loot status and the buyer can change the result.

useCases.title: Handling & durability
useCases.note: Initial source values. The normal furnace produces one result per item and ignores the declared recycle count. Damage, quality, enchantments and item interactions can change other values. Item size is an inventory class, not weight in kilograms.

useCases.title: Container & storage
useCases.note: Capacity and transfer amounts use the game’s source reagent units. Grid space, item footprints, size limits and type restrictions apply together. The item-count ceiling is not the number of objects that fit in the grid. Additional insertion rules can be set during play.

Ordinary tables halve decay; chests, platters, food vendors, artifact backpacks and cooling tables pause it. Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate.

quality.label: Fine
quality.conditions: Base fare before serving. A platter raises food one rank, up to Lavish; favorites and hated foods have separate effects.

value.label: No fixed base value; recipe-derived appraisal may apply
value.conditions: Base source value, not a guaranteed sale quote. Appraisal may randomize it by about 13%; crafted quality, derived recipe prices, loot status and the buyer can change the result.

useCases.title: Handling & durability
useCases.note: Initial source values. The normal furnace produces one result per item and ignores the declared recycle count. Damage, quality, enchantments and item interactions can change other values. Item size is an inventory class, not weight in kilograms.

useCases.title: Container & storage
useCases.note: Capacity and transfer amounts use the game’s source reagent units. Grid space, item footprints, size limits and type restrictions apply together. The item-count ceiling is not the number of objects that fit in the grid. Additional insertion rules can be set during play.

useCases.title: Food & contents
useCases.note: Initial contents and processing targets come from the item definition. Runtime preparation, portion size, quality and serving can change the result.

Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate.

shelfLife.label: Does not rot under the food decay system
shelfLife.conditions: The initial rotprocess is null or false. This does not prevent burning or other damage.

quality.label: Lavish

useCases.title: Handling & durability
useCases.note: Initial source values. The normal furnace produces one result per item and ignores the declared recycle count. Damage, quality, enchantments and item interactions can change other values. Item size is an inventory class, not weight in kilograms.

useCases.title: Container & storage
useCases.note: Capacity and transfer amounts use the game’s source reagent units. Grid space, item footprints, size limits and type restrictions apply together. The item-count ceiling is not the number of objects that fit in the grid. Additional insertion rules can be set during play.

shelfLife.label: About 50 minutes unprotected, then becomes rotten meat
shelfLife.conditions: Approximate time from a newly created item, including its initial warm period, while unprotected. Ordinary tables halve decay; chests, platters, food vendors, artifact backpacks and cooling tables pause it. Already-aged food has less time left; processing ticks make the exact boundary approximate. This decay timer creates the named replacement instead of simply spoiling this item. Replacement waits while the item is held directly by a character. Protected storage pauses this transformation too. The replacement has no further food rot timer.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.

useCases.note: Base intent settings; runtime overrides and character effects can change timings and damage. Deciseconds are tenths of a second.

value.label: No fixed base value; recipe-derived appraisal may apply
value.conditions: Base source value, not a guaranteed sale quote. Appraisal may randomize it by about 13%; crafted quality, derived recipe prices, loot status and the buyer can change the result.

useCases.title: Handling & durability
useCases.note: Initial source values. The normal furnace produces one result per item and ignores the declared recycle count. Damage, quality, enchantments and item interactions can change other values. Item size is an inventory class, not weight in kilograms.

useCases.title: Weapon & shield
useCases.note: Force is the starting melee damage value, not guaranteed health damage. Attack mode, grip, stats, skill, quality, armor and item condition affect the result. A zero wielded override does not mean the weapon deals zero damage.

attacks.name: smash
attacks.description: A powerful, charged up strike that deals normal damage but can throw a standing opponent back and slow them down, based on your strength. Ineffective below 10 strength. Slowdown & Knockback scales to your Strength up to 14 (1 - 4 tiles). Cannot be used consecutively more than every 5 seconds on the same target. Prone targets halve the knockback distance. Not fully charging the attack limits knockback to 1 tile.
